stilt-foot-attachment-type: Specifies how the user's foot attaches to the stilt (e.g., buckle strap, hook & loop, lace-up).
storage-case-type: Indicates the type of container the set comes in for storage and transport (e.g., box, case, bag).
stuffed-animal-features: Highlights built-in play and comfort features of the stuffed animal.

suitable-space: Defines the ideal location for product use, e.g. indoors, above ground

toy-audio-features: Lists the audio capabilities and sound effects built into the toy.
toy-boat-play-features: Highlights notable interactive features of toy boats for discovery and filtering.

toy-bowling-equipment-included: Specifies which bowling components are included in the toy bowling set (e.g., pins, ball, lane/mat, carrying bag).
toy-car-features: Highlights play features integrated into the toy car (separate from propulsion), such as lights, sounds, or opening parts.

toy-drawing-tablet-erase-method: How the drawing surface is cleared/erased.
toy-drawing-tablet-screen-type: The type of drawing/display surface used (e.g., LCD writing tablet vs magnetic).
toy-drawing-tablet-writing-drawing-instr: Primary tool used to draw on the tablet (stylus type).
toy-figure-features: Describes special characteristics of dolls or playsets, like articulated joints or collectible
toy-figure-sound-feature: Indicates whether the animal figure produces sounds and what kind (e.g., roar, realistic animal sound).
toy-figure-theme: Identifies the theme or category of a toy figure, such as animal or sports
toy-game-features: Highlights notable play or construction features relevant to beach and sand toys.
toy-game-material: Identifies the main material used in a toy or game, such as plastic or wood
toy-gift-basket-items-included: Lists the main types of toy items included in the gift basket (for example: plush toy, building set, puzzle).
toy-glider-launch-method: Specifies how the toy glider is launched, which affects play style and shopper expectations.
toy-helicopter-control-type: How the toy helicopter is controlled/operated (independent of propulsion), such as handheld remote, app control, or no control (free flight).
toy-helicopter-features: Key functional features of a toy helicopter (especially RC models) that impact usability and play value.
toy-jacks-set-items-included: Specifies which core items are included with the toy jacks set (e.g., jacks, ball, bag).
toy-keyboard-learning-mode: Indicates the educational/learning approach supported by the toy keyboard (e.g., light-up keys, follow-along songs, guided lessons, app-assisted learning).

toy-kitchen-interactive-features: Highlights interactive elements commonly found in toy kitchens and related accessories.
toy-motorcycle-feature-set: Key play features of the toy motorcycle (select all that apply).

toy-spaceship-features: Indicates common interactive/play features built into the toy spaceship.

toy-tool-electronic-features: Describes interactive/electronic functions of the toy tool (lights, sounds, rotating action, etc.).

toy-tool-type: Identifies the type of toy tool in a pretend play set, like a drill or hammer
